scope: Engineering review for an experimental Quake2 particle path; not a device test or a claim of identical legacy appearance.
decision: Accept localized fixed-point particle sampling changes for the experimental build.
observations: The largest measured change is confined to the blood particle cloud; the scene, weapon, model, and framing match.
Across all eight measured frames the maximum changed count is252 of76800 pixels, and projected vertex positions differ by at most1/16pixel.
Color/alpha values and particle order/count are preserved; texture sampling at the changed pixels can differ visibly at close inspection.
General scene geometry, resolution and particle effects have not been reduced.
